sources.entry: polyfactory - A mock data generation library based on type hints (continuation of pydantic-factories).

summary.one_liner: Polyfactory is a Python mock data generation library that builds test objects from type hints, supporting dataclasses, typed-dicts, Pydantic, msgspec, odmantic and beanie models.
summary.what_it_does: Generates mock data for Python classes by reading their type annotations, so a factory class can produce instances without hand-written fixtures. The README example defines a dataclass with a DataclassFactory subclass and calls build() to get a populated instance. The factory parses the dataclass's typing information and passes generated keyword arguments to the class constructor. It is named in the README as supporting dataclasses, typed-dicts, pydantic models, msgspec structs, odmantic and beanie ODM models, plus custom factories. The library is the successor to pydantic-factories, renamed in version 2.0 when it stopped being tied only to Pydantic. Usage and API docs are linked from the project, though the link target is not shown in the README text.
use_cases: generate fake test data from type hints
create mock dataclass instances in unit tests
build pydantic model fixtures for testing
populate typed-dict objects with random values
mock beanie or odmantic documents in tests
notable: Derives data generation from type hints rather than a separate schema
Successor to pydantic-factories, renamed in version 2.0 to reflect broader support
Part of the Litestar project and actively maintained by its community
Supports custom factories in addition to built-in model types
caveats: README does not describe limits on supported type hint constructs or edge cases
Documentation link target is not included in the README text provided
